name: Len

attributes.attribute: a smith in the old Irish tales
the name carries to the lakes of Kerry

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Len was an Irish hero of the old tales. He is remembered as the smith to the powerful magician Bodb Derg. The lakes by the town of Killarney in Kerry are still called Loch Lein in Irish, in memory of his name.

key_results: He is known as the smith to the magician Bodb Derg.
The Killarney lakes are called Loch Lein in his honor.
